items.title: Arteta zwaar onder de indruk van 'ongelooflijke' relatie Timber met concurrent

Arteta sprak zich onder meer lovend uit over de manier waarop Timber en concullega Ben White de concurrentie aangaan.

His team are bombing in the league after the club’s poorest start since 1986 and out of the Carabao Cup, and after Tuesday’s Champions League defeat at Atlético Madrid Lisandro Martínez showed up ruptures at United by calling out the director of football, Jason Wilcox. items.title: The Florian Wirtz mystery: why has he not found Leverkusen form at Liverpool?
items.summary: Two of our writers pick over the German’s contribution to Liverpool and what the £116m forward could yet produce Some criticism has been OTT and a fee rising to £116m heightens demands but, yes, compared with his performances in Germany and for Germany Wirtz has underwhelmed at Liverpool. The past week has encapsulated his Liverpool career so far. In the Champions League rout of Lask he was everywhere, exploiting gaps between and behind the Austrian club’s defence and knitting together a dominant display against limited opposition. In the previous game against Manchester City, however, when Andoni Iraola needed big players to step up in the absence of Alexander Isak, Cody Gakpo and Dominik Szoboszlai, Wirtz was ineffective, wasteful and withdrawn when his team were chasing the game at 0-1. It also did not help his cause that Rayan Cherki, a cheaper alternative whom Liverpool considered and passed on, completed City’s victory with a sublime goal. AH Continue reading...

items.title: Real Madrid demand La Liga president resign over Goebbels comparison
items.summary: Javier Tebas accuses Madrid of ‘propaganda techniques’ Club want ‘immediate resignation’ for ‘constant attacks’ Real Madrid have again demanded the resignation of the president of La Liga after he compared the club’s efforts to discredit referees with the propaganda techniques of Nazi Germany. Javier Tebas lashed out at Madrid on Friday on social media with a long post that criticised how its club television channel says referees hurt its chances of winning. The channel regularly runs reels of what it considers gross errors by match officials who are set to work upcoming games for the 15-time European champions. Continue reading...

items.title: Mikel Arteta defends job cuts at Arsenal to help club ‘evolve and create success’
items.summary: Up to 60 roles at risk after structural review Arteta signed new deal worth more than £20m a season Mikel Arteta has defended Arsenal’s decision to cut up to 60 jobs and insisted it was felt to be necessary to ensure they can continue achieving success. The Premier League champions are understood to have informed the staff whose positions are at risk after a consultation process started by Boston Consulting Group (BCG) before the end of last season. Arsenal hope the number of redundancies can be reduced and will attempt to redeploy affected employees wherever possible, although some job losses may be unavoidable. Continue reading...

items.title: Un attaquant gantois vêtu d'une veste...du Club de Bruges : la scène qui fait parler au nord du pays
items.summary: Entre La Gantoise et le Club de Bruges, la rivalité se renouvelle d'année en année. Entre les banderoles moqueuses (parfois même brandies par les joueurs), les codes postaux écrits dans le rond central et autres provocations, les esprits s'échauffent vite. Cette fois, c'est un petit détail qui a fait parler.
